# `issue_85_parent_{before,after}_*.ipc.bin`

Eight `kiapi.board.types.FootprintInstance` messages, serialised verbatim as
KiCad 10.0.8's IPC API returned them, before and after a live
`update_footprints_from_library` apply on a 2-layer board containing four stock
KiCad 10.0.8 footprints (`#85`, part B — parent-field compatibility).

## Provenance

| | |
|---|---|
| KiCad | 10.0.8 (`kicad-cli --version` → `10.0.8`), `pcbnew` under headless Weston (`KICAD_CONFIG_HOME` isolated) |
| Source board | Scratch 2-layer board built with `pcbnew` Python from stock `/usr/share/kicad/footprints/*.pretty`: `NT1` (`NetTie:NetTie-2_SMD_Pad0.5mm`, pad 1 on `GND`, pad 2 on `AGND`), `D1` (`LED_THT:LED_D5.0mm`, board-only property `BoardNote = "keep-me"`, member of board-level `PCB_GROUP` `LedGroup`), `Q1` (`OptoDevice:Osram_SFH2201`, custom-shape pads), and `C1` (`Capacitor_SMD:C_0603_1608Metric`, unselected control). One `PCB_SHAPE` graphic was removed from each of `NT1`, `D1`, and `Q1` so refresh planned a real `graphics` update. |
| Transport | `GetItems(KOT_PCB_FOOTPRINT)` over `/tmp/kicad/api.sock` before and after `update_footprints_from_library` (`references: ["NT1", "D1", "Q1"]`), followed by a second dry run on all four footprints (`status: "noop"`). |
| Captured | 2026-11-27 |

## Observed KiCad 10.0.8 `parent` KIID behavior

| Message / field | Sent in `UpdateItems` | Before refresh (`GetItems`) | After refresh (`GetItems`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FootprintInstance.parent` | Preserved from `before` | Board KIID (`854faaeb-01c3-40c1-9b61-3e5ae806c703`) — even when `D1` belongs to `PCB_GROUP` `LedGroup` | Preserved unchanged (board KIID); `LedGroup.items` still holds `D1`'s KIID |
| `FootprintInstance.{reference,value,datasheet,description}_field.text.parent` | Preserved from `before` | Parent footprint's KIID | Preserved unchanged (`text.id` and `text.parent` unchanged) |
| Board-only custom `Field.text.parent` (`D1` `BoardNote`) | Preserved from `before` | Parent footprint's KIID | Preserved unchanged (`text.id` and `text.parent` unchanged) |
| Rebuilt library `Pad.parent` | `None` | Parent footprint's KIID | Regenerated by KiCad to parent footprint's KIID (fresh `id`) |
| Rebuilt custom pad `custom_shapes[*].parent` (`Q1`) | `None` | Parent footprint's KIID (not `Pad.id`) | Regenerated by KiCad to parent footprint's KIID (fresh `id`) |
| Rebuilt `BoardGraphicShape.parent` | `None` | Parent footprint's KIID | Regenerated by KiCad to parent footprint's KIID (fresh `id`) |
| Rebuilt `BoardText.parent` (`fp_text user`) | `None` | Parent footprint's KIID | Regenerated by KiCad to parent footprint's KIID (fresh `id`) |
| Rebuilt `ReferencePoint.parent` (`D1`) | `None` | Parent footprint's KIID | Regenerated by KiCad to parent footprint's KIID (fresh `id`) |
| Rebuilt library custom `Field.text.parent` (`KiLib_Generator`) | `None` | Parent footprint's KIID | Regenerated by KiCad to parent footprint's KIID (fresh `text.id`) |
| Unselected footprint (`C1`) | Not sent | Identical bytes | Byte-for-byte identical (`7c4fbca4e3e6baa4`) |

## Validation debt

Parent-field preservation and child-parent regeneration were observed directly on
KiCad 10.0.8. KiCad 10.0.6 and 10.0.7 follow `board_types.proto` (`Since: 10.0.6`) and
remain unobserved.

## Redaction

Nothing was removed. The captures contain only stock KiCad library strings,
net names `GND` and `AGND`, the synthetic property `BoardNote = "keep-me"`,
protobuf type URLs, and KIIDs. No board path, username, or hostname appears.
